notes: Synthetic: from xAI's OpenAPI spec as published in its official SDK, github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-ts spec/openapi.json at 51bfc686c74310226d601e6037fa6c2e562244f7 (2026-10-28; pinned as contractspec/subsets/xai). latest is the model every example of the spec names (ChatRequest.model's example). text_basic is POST /v1/chat/completions' request and 200 examples verbatim (ChatResponse). Its usage counts the reasoning tokens in total_tokens and not in completion_tokens (32 + 9 + 94 reasoning = 135), gap XA1. text_end_turn is the same example with finish_reason "end_turn", the third value the finish_reason description names beside stop and length (the spec gives no enum), gap XA2. stream_text follows ChatResponseChunk (id, object, created, model, choices[] {index, delta, finish_reason}, service_tier, system_fingerprint, usage on the last chunk) with the 200 example's values split into deltas, data lines alone and data: [DONE] at the end, as ChatRequest.stream describes. responses_text is POST /v1/responses' request and 200 examples verbatim (ModelResponse); list_models is GET /v1/models' 200 example verbatim (filed here because the request names no model). The error bodies are the SDK's own (the same SDK's tests at that commit, test/errors.test.ts): error_invalid_model is "exposes structured error details" ({error: {type, code, param, message}}, 400), responses_error_invalid_argument is "uses a string error field as the message" ({code, error: "<message>"}, 400), the flat form src/errors.ts errorFromResponse reads beside OpenAI's (gap XA3); the spec declares 400 and 422 without a body.

known gap O1: message.refusal is dropped (models.Message has no refusal field). A structured-outputs refusal arrives as content null plus a refusal string, so the client receives content null, no refusal and finish_reason "stop": an empty answer it cannot tell from a refusal. null in every case without a refusal

known gap XA3: xAI's flat error body {"code", "error": "<message>"}, the form its SDK parses beside OpenAI's, does not decode: error is a string where models.ErrorResponse expects an object, so parseProviderError falls back to a 502 with the raw body as the message, and a 400 is retried, failed over and counted against the circuit breaker

allowed_unknown_shapes.reason: known gap XA2: xAI's finish_reason "end_turn" passes through unmapped: not a canonical finish reason, so the inbound translators (Anthropic, Gemini) fall back to a default and clients that switch on finish_reason miss it
